summary: Add a 6-line GROUNDING block to the handle_knowledge system prompt (hotel_langgraph.py ~lines 631-646) that tells the model to (a) repeat exactly the items listed in HOTEL INFORMATION, no padding, and (b) use a fixed partial-answer template ("I don't have that specific detail...") for any sub-fact the guest asked about that isn't in the retrieved context. Crucially the rule is scoped to the MISSING SUB-FACT only — the rest of the answer proceeds normally — which avoids iter7's failure mode of refusing whole turns.
root_cause: The handle_knowledge system prompt (hotel_langgraph.py L631-646) instructs the model to "Be direct and specific. Include times, prices, locations" and to "answer the guest's question above" using HOTEL INFORMATION, but never closes the loophole that the model may fill enumerated gaps (lists of views, embassy phone numbers, amenity prices) from its training priors when the retrieved chunk under-specifies the answer. The model treats "list room views" as a question it must answer completely, so when RAG returns 3 view options it pads to 4 with plausible extras (Mountain View, Ocean View); when RAG fails to surface the Chinese embassy line (which DOES exist in emergency_contacts.md L106 but didn't make it into the top-k chunks) the model substitutes a memorised-looking +66 number. Defect 4 is true hallucination (KB has City/Garden/Panoramic/360, no Mountain or Ocean — Bangkok hotel), defect 5 is a retrieval miss compounded by the same prior-padding behaviour. Both share the same prompt-side mitigation: a soft grounding rule that allows the model to still answer everything else but blocks invention of specific named values not present in the retrieved context.
fix_strategy: Insert a 6-bullet GROUNDING block into the existing OUTPUT FORMAT system message in handle_knowledge, placed AFTER the LIVE PRICING bullet and BEFORE the {extra_context} interpolation. The block uses soft-positive language (anchored on "use exactly what HOTEL INFORMATION lists") with a concrete enumeration example (views) and a concrete named-value example (embassy phone) so the model has near-domain anchors. It supplies a fixed bilingual micro-template for the missing-detail case so the model has a drop-in pattern rather than reasoning about refusal. Critically the rule is scoped to the SPECIFIC missing sub-fact ("for that ONE detail say...; answer the rest normally") to prevent iter7's whole-turn refusal regression. No global instruction, no change to main_prompt, no change to retrieval — purely a localised tightening of the handle_knowledge system message. Keeps T=0.3, max_tokens=1024, all other behaviour intact.

files_touched.location_hint: Inside handle_knowledge(), the second ('system', f"""...""") block of rag_prompt (currently lines 631-646). Add a new GROUNDING block between the existing LIVE PRICING bullet (ending line 644) and the blank line + {extra_context} interpolation (lines 645-646).
files_touched.rationale: Localised edit to one prompt string in one sub-agent. No code-path, retrieval, routing, or tool-call changes. Soft-positive wording with concrete examples + a fixed partial-answer template + explicit 'answer the rest normally' clause is designed to avoid iter7's over-refusal failure mode. Reversible by deleting 6 lines.

         ("system", main_prompt),
         ("human", last_user_message),
         ("system", f"""Use this hotel information to answer the guest's question above.
 Be direct and specific. Include times, prices, locations.
 Answer in the same language the guest used.
 
 OUTPUT FORMAT — STRICT:
 - Do NOT write code blocks (triple-backtick fences).
 - Do NOT write pseudo tool-calls like `search_hotel_knowledge(...)` or
   `check_room_availability(...)`. The information below already IS the
   search result — just answer with it directly.
 - Do NOT preface the answer with "I'll search …" or "Let me look up …"
   — go straight to the facts.
 - If a LIVE PRICING block is shown, use THOSE numbers (they already
   include any Early Bird discount or Last-Minute surcharge) instead of
   the rate card numbers from HOTEL INFORMATION.

+GROUNDING — answer ONLY from HOTEL INFORMATION below:
+- When HOTEL INFORMATION lists a specific set of items (e.g. view options,
+  room types, amenities, contact numbers), repeat EXACTLY those items. If
+  it lists 3 views, name those 3 — do not add a 4th (no "Mountain View",
+  no "Ocean View") just because it sounds plausible for a hotel.
+- For a specific phone number, address, embassy, price, or named amenity
+  the guest asks about: only state it if it appears verbatim in HOTEL
+  INFORMATION. Never reconstruct one from general knowledge.
+- If that ONE specific detail is missing from HOTEL INFORMATION, say for
+  that detail only: "ขออภัยค่ะ ข้อมูลนี้ไม่มีในสมุดติดต่อของโรงแรม

+  that specific detail in our directory — please contact the front desk
+  (or the embassy directly)." Then continue to answer everything else the
+  guest asked using the information you DO have. Do not refuse the whole
+  turn just because one sub-fact is missing.
 
 {extra_context}"""),
     ])

live_smoke_test.before_question: Two probes, in the same language as the live defect: (1) Thai: "ค่าห้องดีลักซ์เท่าไหร่คะ มีวิวอะไรให้เลือกบ้าง" (2) Chinese: "中国大使馆的电话号码是多少？"
live_smoke_test.before_failure_signature: (1) Reply enumerates 4 view options including 'Mountain View' and/or 'Ocean View' (KB has only City / Garden / Panoramic city / 360). (2) Reply returns a confident '+66 2 245 7032' or similar +66 number with no hedge, even when the embassy chunk didn't surface in the retrieved context.
live_smoke_test.after_question: Re-run the same two probes after the prompt edit and uvicorn reload. Also run a control probe to confirm no over-refusal regression: Thai: "สระว่ายน้ำเปิดกี่โมงคะ" (pool hours — a fact that IS in the KB; must still answer normally).
live_smoke_test.after_pass_criteria: PASS = all three hold: (a) Thai room-view probe lists ONLY view options that appear in retrieved HOTEL INFORMATION (no Mountain/Ocean View added); rest of the room-rate answer is still complete (price, size, occupancy). (b) Chinese embassy probe either quotes the embassy line verbatim if it surfaced, OR returns the bilingual 'I don't have that specific detail / ขออภัย... กรุณาติดต่อสถานทูตโดยตรง' template — NOT an invented +66 number. (c) Pool-hours control probe still answers directly with times from KB (no spurious 'I don't have that detail' refusal). FAIL = any invented view name, any embassy number not present in retrieved context, OR any refusal on the pool-hours control (iter7 regression signature).
